lines.say: Do you need a deload week?
A deload is a planned easy week. Less weight, fewer sets, or a break.
The idea: your body recovers, and you come back stronger.
A twenty twenty four study tested it. Trained lifters did nine weeks. One group took a week off in the middle.
Muscle growth? The same. But the deload group gained a bit less leg strength.
So you don't need one on a schedule just because it's week six.
Take one when your joints ache, sleep is bad, or your lifts keep dropping. Then come back hungry.
